milestone: Harness kernel: sessions, claims, review-gated approval

sprints.goal: Local hub coordination, feature intake, and operator UI

tickets.title: Local team dashboard for backlog cards and hub chat
acceptance: Stdlib HTTP dashboard on 127.0.0.1 with a per-launch token and Host check; no public bind.
Kanban of backlog tickets plus a Requested column; card detail shows acceptance, handoff, and related messages.
Sessions panel and chat: Roman can send as sender roman to one session or all, plus a team feed.
Hub feature_requests support submit/list/link; backlog remains single-writer (integrator links requests to RL IDs).
Telegram and hosted auth stay out of scope.
No product or contract changes.
validation: Hub unit tests plus check_repo; document how to launch the dashboard and obtain the token.

tickets.title: Minimal-token agent onboarding via hub help
acceptance: hub.py help with no keyword lists topics sessions, claims, inbox, mcp, startup, and watch, plus any overlay topics.
help <keyword> prints a short stable parseable command list (exact CLI, --holder where required, absolute RL_AGENT_HUB_DB, paths). Not essays. Empty or huge output fails.
Unknown keyword raises.
help startup covers a fresh checkout spin-up and explicit non-starts (no product services or dashboard unless asked; no GPU; processes terminate).
AGENTS.md stays short and contains a load-bearing help stanza that must not be dropped from a summary.
No product, contract, Cursor-only skill, Telegram, or auto-started daemons.
validation: Hub unit tests for every listed topic, unknown-keyword error, and startup text on a temp empty DB; python tools/check_repo.py; AGENTS.md remains short.

tickets.title: Watch idle-exit so a dead session becomes takeable
acceptance: hub.py watch stops renewing and exits with the stop sentinel and reason idle when the session has had no holder-attributed write for an idle window (default 10 minutes, --idle-exit to change).
Holder-attributed writes: locker-save, send, ticket claim/release, and inbox cursor advance. Renewing the session lease itself never counts.
A session whose agent keeps writing is never exited. A superseded holder still exits as today.
The dead session then reaches its normal lease expiry and any agent can take it with session-start. No sweeper, death notices, busy flag, new tables, or schema change.
docs/development.md: a watcher does not keep a dead session alive; worst case for takeover is the idle window plus the remaining lease.
validation: Hub unit tests with patched time: idle watcher exits, active session keeps running, superseded holder exits; python tools/check_repo.py.

tickets.title: Shared inbox watch CLI
acceptance: hub.py watch --session --holder polls that inbox, renews the session lease only, and prints one AGENT_LOOP_WAKE_hub-inbox sentinel per new message id.
Exits nonzero if the holder is superseded; silent session-start is not RL-013 liveness.
AGENTS.md or help sessions/watch tells agents to run this command in their IDE wake hook and not invent a second loop.
No master-app supervisor, no auto-started product services, no product changes.
validation: Hub unit tests with a temp DB for new mail, idle poll, and superseded holder; python tools/check_repo.py.

tickets.title: Hub kernel config and message kinds
acceptance: Config names backlog path, session-id pattern, reserved resources, and check_repo required docs.
send stores kind fyi|review|wake|death; default fyi. Operator roman can send without a session holder.
This repo's committed config still requires the existing spec files. A temp config without game specs must not require them.
No package publish, Telegram, hosted HTTP, or product content changes.
validation: Hub unit tests for kinds, operator send, and invalid config; python tools/check_repo.py.

tickets.title: Split AGENTS.md kernel from product overlay
acceptance: AGENTS.md keeps help stanza and session/work protocol only; no product versions, vendor assets, or product constants.
Product invariants remain in CLAUDE.md or docs/product-contract.md.
Help topics split kernel vs overlay; land after or with RL-012 so hub.py help exists.
AGENTS.md stays under 4000 characters.
validation: python tools/check_repo.py; AGENTS.md must not contain product names or constants; help tests if RL-012 has landed.

tickets.title: Dashboard merge queue after independent review
acceptance: Merge tab lists a ticket only after an independent review with no blocking findings and an unchanged reviewed branch head.
Row shows remaining non-blocking comments; Approve binds ticket+branch+full SHA and authorizes the integrator only (never auto-merge).
Send with comments records/sends feedback and returns the item to changes requested; a hub message is not an approval.
Roman yes in a direct agent chat remains valid and is recordable as source=chat for the same exact SHA.
No product or contract changes.
validation: Hub/dashboard unit tests for queue membership, moved head, approve vs comments, and chat-sourced approval; python tools/check_repo.py.

tickets.title: Skeptic role, charter, and debate marks
acceptance: Read-only charter states the repository's purpose.
Tickets carry skeptic clear|watch|flagged|debate|kept|scrubbed.
flagged or debate cannot stay ready, in_progress, review, or done.
help skeptic explains pickup, flag, and three-vote debate.
No product or contract changes.
validation: python tools/check_repo.py; hub help lists overlay skeptic.

tickets.title: Name holder persist mode on the hub API
acceptance: sessions() persist is oneshot or watch; absent locker persist line means oneshot.
locker-save rejects any persist value other than oneshot or watch (fail fast).
help sessions and help watch name the two modes and forbid a second poller or session-start heartbeat.
No new loop, daemon, sweeper, busy flag, table, or schema. Product listeners stay docs-only adapters on existing watch sentinels.
validation: python -m unittest discover -s tools/agent_hub/tests -v; python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.

tickets.title: Approve pending feature requests from the Merge tab
acceptance: Merge tab lists status=new feature requests that still need Roman's yes, each with an Approve button.
Approve is a signed operator action (same key as merge approvals); a hub message is not FR approval; it does not auto-file a ticket or merge code.
Existing review-merge Approve path is unchanged. No product or contract changes.
validation: Hub/dashboard unit tests: new FRs appear, Approve records operator yes, a chat message does not; python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.

tickets.title: Announce a free integrator seat; drop ended sessions
acceptance: If agent-session-1 has been free for more than 300 seconds, send one team-wide message that the integrator seat is available and should be picked up. Do not spam; one notice per vacancy.
A graceful session-end removes that session from sessions() so closed seats do not accumulate.

sessions() reports active_at and idle_seconds from holder-attributed writes only (never session-lease renewal), plus the non-session leases that session holds. Dashboard shows those facts and does not infer blocked vs dead.
No new sweeper daemon, busy flag, or always-on process: reuse dashboard poll or existing watch/idle-exit signals. RL-013 forbids a hub sweeper. No product or contract changes.
validation: Hub/dashboard unit tests with patched time: vacancy notice once after 300s free; session-end drops the session; idle_seconds ignores lease renew; python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.

tickets.title: Priority scheduling so agents do not idle-block each other
acceptance: Debate keep/scrub a written scheduling rule that reduces idle time without greedy blocking (wrong-priority claims, contracts pile-up).
If kept: the rule is one short policy in docs/development.md plus backlog fields if needed. No scheduler daemon, sweeper, or auto-assign bot.
No product or contract changes. Do not implement during debate.
validation: Debate keep/scrub; if kept, python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.

tickets.title: Owner-scoped experiments log in the hub
acceptance: Hub table experiments with natural run_id; read is open; write only the live owner-session holder; final rows are immutable.
CLI start/record/final/list/get; operator reassign. No sweep scheduler, no checkpoint bytes in SQLite, no daemon.
FR-4 file manifests are not built. No product or contract changes.
validation: Hub unit tests: owner write, non-owner refused, superseded holder refused, final immutable, natural-key idempotent; python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.

tickets.title: Publish the team harness as a separate git repo
acceptance: Debate keep/scrub extracting tools/agent_hub, tests, demonstrations, and docs into a push-ready repo that excludes the product.
If kept: two inspector agents review that extract only after this card is ready. The origin repository keeps the product and its contracts.
No push during debate. No GPU. No operator.key. No sweeper.
validation: Debate keep/scrub recorded. If kept later: hub tests plus python tools/check_repo.py and a tree without any product files. No GPU.

tickets.title: Secret keys stay off the wire and out of agents
acceptance: A local wrap/use protocol lets a program call AI HTTP APIs with a user-owned key that never appears in hub messages, lockers, git, SQLite, or agent context.
Agents and external infra see a handle at most, never secret bytes. operator.key and merge approvals are unchanged.
No product or contract changes. No sweeper. Do not implement until ready.
validation: Hub tests: holder cannot read another user's key bytes; CLI/logs refuse secrets; python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.

tickets.title: Done column shows newest ten with show-more
acceptance: Dashboard Done column is ordered by most recently completed.
Show the top 10 by default with a show 10 more control at the bottom.
No product or contract changes. No hub schema change.
validation: Dashboard unit test: recency order, first page 10, more appends 10; python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.

tickets.title: Integrator force-end with a signed operator pointer
acceptance: Live integrator holder can force-end a named occupied session only when the call points at a signed operator instruction (same key family as merge approvals).
A hub message, including sender roman, is not the instruction. Other agents can verify the signature and refuse a forgery.
No product or contract changes. No sweeper. Not the integrator's implementation seat.
validation: Hub tests: unsigned or forged instruction refused; signed operator pointer accepted only from the live integrator holder; python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.

tickets.title: Retire free leftover seats after idle-exit
acceptance: A session that is already free after idle-exit plus lease expiry does not sit in sessions() forever with leftover persist:watch and growing idle_seconds.
Occupied leases stay the RL-050 path. No sweeper, no idle-exit default change, no product or contract changes. Do not implement from the integrator seat.
validation: Hub/dashboard tests with patched time: free leftover is retired or not shown as occupied; occupied lease unchanged; python tools/check_repo.py. No GPU.
